claude_code.how: Use the CLI against the selected archive, with daemon startup before daemon-backed queries. Optional MCP is documented as command agentsview with args ["mcp"], using stdio for local Claude Code clients. Local MCP resolves/starts the daemon; it does not fall back to direct SQLite reads when daemon startup is disabled. This registration is optional.

codex.how: Use the CLI through CommandExecution against the selected archive. Optional upstream MCP uses agentsview mcp over stdio, documented for Codex as well as Claude Code (https://github.com/kenn-io/agentsview/blob/v0.44.0/docs/commands.md). Its tools can search sessions, fetch messages and summarize usage, subject to their own filters; MCP adoption is not required for the CLI workflow.

official_baseline_claims.claim: Source for latest_release and latest_date: fresh live checks on 2026-09-27 UTC returned tag_name v0.44.0 and published_at 2026-09-21T13:56:12Z. The immediately preceding published release is v0.43.0, and the tags list also starts at v0.44.0.

Upstream describes local session browsing/search and cost tracking across coding agents, with the archive kept locally unless a sharing feature is selected. This is an observation/retrieval capability, not an official token-savings measurement.

The CLI documents offline sync with AGENTSVIEW_NO_DAEMON=1 and separately documents daemon-backed read commands. Disabling autostart does not stop an existing daemon or bypass its archive ownership lock.
Upstream offers an optional read-only MCP surface over stdio, with a separate HTTP option. Local MCP is daemon-backed and resolves the daemon on tool calls.

A separate agentsview capture workflow is documented for measuring one exact non-interactive execution without the normal daemon, server, watchers or archive. It should not be confused with the normal projects/session-query workflow.

limitations.text: The changelog dates the daemon-transport requirement for affected CLI read commands to v0.35.1, 2026-06-30. Direct SQLite access remains available for documented dedicated/offline operations; it was not removed for every command.

At the installed v0.43.0 pin, ensureTransportContext explicitly refuses read intent when no usable daemon exists and autostart is disabled, directing the user to agentsview daemon start or to unset AGENTSVIEW_NO_DAEMON. This matches the retained failure condition.

session search defaults --include-automated, --include-one-shot and --include-children to false in both v0.43.0 (https://github.com/kenn-io/agentsview/blob/v0.43.0/cmd/agentsview/session_search.go#L125) and v0.44.0. The common search request carries these flags regardless of selecting --fts; omitted flags can exclude matching sessions.

At v0.44.0 the usage CLI builds db.UsageFilter without setting ExcludeAutomated or ExcludeOneShot; both remain false, and its HTTP adapter explicitly requests the inverse inclusion flags. Thus CLI usage reporting includes those session classes.

At v0.44.0 get_usage_summary sets IncludeOneShot=true but omits IncludeAutomated, and its input schema exposes no include_automated parameter. The service converts that omitted false value into ExcludeAutomated=true (https://github.com/kenn-io/agentsview/blob/v0.44.0/internal/service/usage.go#L208). This is a real CLI/MCP default-population mismatch; adding an unsupported argument is not a documented remedy.
The changelog file at the v0.44.0 tag still labels its leading section Unreleased and names v0.43.0 as latest. Use the live GitHub release object for release identity rather than that stale heading.

new_since_pin.text: Released in the successor: PR #1855, merged 2026-09-20, reads Codex session_meta originator=codex_exec into session_kind=non-interactive. thread_source=roborev overrides it with the more specific roborev kind, and the automated classifier accepts both kinds. This verifies the classification change from the actual parser/classifier diff, rather than from a prior summary.

The same PR raises dataVersion from 111 to 112 specifically so existing Codex-format rows reparse and persist the classification; its changelog hunk instructs restart or agentsview sync. This describes the migration introduced by the PR, not a claim that later versions cannot have a higher data version.

v0.44.0 is the published successor to the installed v0.43.0; its release notes include the Codex exec automated-session change. Other main-branch changes after this tag are not part of the published successor.

The 36-hour scan ending 2026-09-26T23:37:28Z detects use by 32/1010 Ultracode workflow children (3.17%, 238 CLI detections), 1/301 Codex workers (0.33%, 11), and 1/22 children given the lanes block (4.55%, 1) (invoke_by_tool.json).
